blocks.heading_context: ### The Cell Theory's Significance for Biology
blocks.text:
BEFORE CELL THEORY:                AFTER CELL THEORY:

Biology is: taxonomy, anatomy,     Biology is organized around:
           physiology (qualitative) - Cell structure and function
                                   - Cell reproduction
           No unifying framework   - Processes that happen in cells

Disease explanation: miasma,       Disease explanation: altered
humors, divine punishment          cellular function (Virchow)
                                   --> cellular pathology

Growth/development:                Growth = cell division + specialization
mysterious "vital processes"       Development = differential gene expression
                                   (we now know)

blocks.heading_context: ### The Four Key Elements of Natural Selection
blocks.text:
NATURAL SELECTION REQUIRES:

1. VARIATION
   Individuals in a population differ from each other.
   (Darwin knew this empirically; didn't know the mechanism)

2. HERITABILITY
   Variation is passed from parents to offspring.
   (Darwin knew this empirically; Mendel had the mechanism
   but they never connected)

3. DIFFERENTIAL REPRODUCTION
   Some variants leave more offspring than others.
   This is selection -- NOT random.

4. SUFFICIENT TIME
   Small differences compound over geological time.
   Lyell's uniformitarianism established that Earth was old enough.

RESULT: Populations change over time.
Accumulated changes over sufficient time: new species.

DARWIN'S MECHANISM:
Variation + heritability + selection + time -->
adaptation + speciation + the tree of life
### Why It Was Ignored for 35 Years

blocks.heading_context: ## Bridges — Biology Revolution as Information Systems
blocks.text: The Modern Synthesis (1930s–1950s) united: Darwin's selection mechanism + Mendel's genetics + population genetics (Fisher, Wright, Haldane) + paleontology (Simpson) + systematics (Mayr). Before the synthesis, these were separate research programs that didn't communicate and sometimes appeared contradictory. After: natural selection operates on Mendelian variation; population genetics makes the mechanism quantitative; fossil record shows tempo and mode; systematics provides the classification framework. The synthesis didn't refute any of the component programs — it showed they were compatible and mutually reinforcing. This is the framework-integration pattern: sometimes the value-add is not a new theory but a demonstration that existing theories are consistent, and a common vocabulary that enables cross-domain work.
